profile.headline: Software Engineer II at IBM Cloud

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
SMU Coding Boot Camp is a part-time, 24-week Full Stack Flex course that gives students the knowledge and skills to build dynamic end-to-end web applications and become a full stack web developer. The program is rigorous and fast-paced and covers both the theory and application of
web development.
 
+ Support Students 
+ Code Review  Student Projects
+ Demo Technologies (JavaScript, MERN  Stack, Github)
+ One On One Tutoring Sessions

https://codingbootcamp.smu.edu/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: GivePulse is a startup company focused on enabling people to create impacts throughout their community through volunteerism. It is a fast-paced work environment with high demands. With our small development team we work efficiently, and endlessly to meet the needs of our clients, wearing multiple hats during the process.

positions.title: Student, Front-End Engineering
positions.description:
The Iron Yard is a 12-week immersive code school.
Focused on Front-End Web Development

+Learned Javascript, React, Backbone, HTML, CSS
+Built applications with various API's using AJAX/jQuery
+Used Firebase to implement Data Persistence

positions.title: Lead Compounding Tech, RPhT
positions.description:
+Compounded and dispensed  Sterile and Non-sterile Medications. 
+Taught and supervised 4th year pharmacist interns to ensure competency of  compounding techniques and knowledge. 
+Marketed to Doctors, Hospitals, and Surgery Centers. 
+Trained and supervised incoming employees. 
+Maintained and fixed all computer and network related problems.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Wilcrest Medical Center: Ralph F. Coleman, MD
volunteerExperiences.description:
Dr. Coleman is a General Practitioner. I was able to learn so much from him. His depth of medical knowledge and life wisdom will be forever appreciated. 

-Helped check in patients
-Took patients vitals
-Sat in on Doctor to Patient consultations
-Drew blood from patients as needed
-Ordered necessary tests

company.name: Wilcrest Medical Center: Ralph F. Coleman, MD

volunteerExperiences.description:
Dr. James Stamper specialized in Pediatric Dentistry. I had the amazing opportunity to work with children and special needs patients during my time here.

Assisted In:
-Orthopedic Procedures
-Root Canal Treatment
-Molar Extractions
-Dental Fillings
-Sterilized dental tools
